texts.copy.faq.0.0: What can I actually manage in Vectrum?
texts.copy.faq.0.1: Your trucks, trailers, drivers, documents, service and daily transport operations, all in one place. Keep the information your team needs together instead of switching between spreadsheets and messengers.
texts.copy.faq.1.0: How does vehicle service tracking work?
texts.copy.faq.1.1: Vehicle records bring together service history, planned maintenance, documents and reported issues. Your team can see what needs attention and plan the next action.
texts.copy.faq.2.0: Will Vectrum really save me time?
texts.copy.faq.2.1: Connected orders, tracking, documents and communication reduce repeated data entry. Your team can spend more time organizing transport and less time looking for information.
texts.copy.faq.3.0: What about communication with the team?
texts.copy.faq.3.1: Company chat, files, photos and calls connect drivers and dispatchers in Vectrum Driver and Vectrum Logist.
texts.copy.faq.4.0: Can I use Vectrum for my whole company?
texts.copy.faq.4.1: Yes. Owners assign roles and individual access rights, so dispatchers, drivers, mechanics and finance teams work with the information they are authorized to see.

texts.pages.aboutTitle: We make it easier for you
texts.pages.aboutLead: We’re building the operating layer that lets transport companies run orders, fleet, tracking and finance from a single connected system, built in the EU for road transport.
texts.pages.whyBody: Transport operations should not depend on a patchwork of disconnected tools. Orders, dispatch, fleet, tracking, freight market and finance belong in one connected workspace.
texts.pages.whySecond: Vectrum brings the team and its information together. From planning a load to following a vehicle and keeping its documents in order, the next step stays connected to the work already done.
texts.pages.quote: One workspace for the people who keep transport moving.
texts.pages.principlesLead: Working principles we return to, screen by screen
texts.pages.principle0Body: Orders, vehicles, drivers and documents stay connected in a shared workspace.
texts.pages.principle1Body: Clear information and direct actions keep everyday operations moving.
texts.pages.principle2Body: Automation helps with routine work. Your team reviews the results and stays in control.
texts.pages.principle3Body: Drivers, dispatchers and owners work together with access appropriate to their roles.
